# About Henrik Becker

## Key facts
- **Name:** Henrik Becker
- **Role:** Senior .NET Consultant
- **Current status:** Freelance consultant through Henrik Becker Consulting AB. Left Betsson in December 2025 and went back to freelancing. Available for new assignments.
- **Born:** 1969-06-23 (1969)
- **Nationality:** Swedish
- **Location:** Lidingö, Stockholm, Sweden
- **Working professionally with software since:** 1999
- **Company:** Henrik Becker Consulting AB, founded 2017. Assignments since October 2017 have been delivered through it, unless noted otherwise.

## Description
Henrik started working with software development in 1999, during the IT boom in Stockholm. He is a senior backend consultant who has worked a lot with system integration, and has used every major version of .NET and ASP.NET, from Web Forms to today's APIs. He focuses on backend development, automation and integration, with clean code built on SOLID principles.

# Henrik Becker - Senior .NET Consultant   
## Introduction
Senior .NET consultant and solutions architect focused on backend development, integration and delivery automation. More than 25 years of building systems that stay easy to change, with TDD and DevOps as everyday practice.

- **Backend development** (.NET, C#, ASP.NET)
- **System integration** (REST, SOAP, Messaging based architecture, Event Sourcing)
- **Application development in Azure** (Functions, Service Bus, API Management)
- **Automation and CI/CD pipelines**
- **Clean code, SOLID principles, TDD, DDD**
